capabilities: Render a tabbed D&D 2024 character sheet inside a note
Create characters with a full wizard or a beginner quick-start
Track inventory, attunement slots, weight and currency
Compute attack bonus, damage and AC from linked item notes
Import D&D Beyond characters and export the sheet to PDF
extras: Requires Meta Bind (with its JavaScript option enabled) and JS Engine to render correctly, and Readable line length must be turned off. The public release ships only SRD 5.2.1 species, classes, subclasses and spells; an example vault with items, spells, monsters, feats, conditions and senses is provided separately.
intentEvidence: Built to replace Dataview-based character sheets
motivation: The author wanted to replace dataviewjs-based sheets with MarkdownRenderChild code block processors so editing one field does not force a multi-second refresh.
problem: Dataview-based character sheets re-render on every metadata change, so editing one field makes the whole sheet slow and fragile.

relations.evidence: Built to replace Dataview-based character sheets
This plugin's sheet relies on two other community plugins to actually render correctly
Install and enable both before creating a character, or the sheet will render incompletely
clickable roll buttons on Hit/Damage and Spell Attack/Save numbers
assigns an icon to every new character note
If the Atlas VTT plugin is installed, every character gets a hidden statblock copy

summary: Interactive D&D 2024 character sheet rendered from Markdown notes, with a creation wizard, level-up, inventory, spells, PDF export and D&D Beyond import.
